**Yes, the evidence indicates native forest loss on this property in 2022, though it is small.**

- Hansen data show a 2022 tree-cover loss event of 0.6 ha, about 3.4% of the 17.6 ha property. That is above the 0.5 ha minimum event size.
- The JRC 2020 map classes all of that area as forest, and later years of the series were observed. This meets the corroboration rule.
- The MGAP 2021 forest map classes about 0.5 ha of the event as native forest and none as planted forest. The other 0.1 ha is outside mapped forest.
- A further 0.2 ha of loss in patches under 0.5
